row['followup_execution_cost_history']=[row.get('followup_execution_cost',{})] row['followup_execution_cost']={'new_model_fits':state['model_fits_started'],'new_accounts':len(state['account_jobs']),'prior_cumulative_fits':103,'cumulative_fits':103+state['model_fits_started'],'repeatability_fits':4,'old_other_seed_fits':4,'determinism_parameter_fits':0} execution=row['execution_audit'];execution['original_seven_h_fits']=35;execution['supplementary_fits']=state['model_fits_started'];execution['actual_new_fits']=35+state['model_fits_started'];execution['successful_fits']=35+sum(j['status']=='succeeded' [42,1000,2000,3000,4000]]+[str(ROOT/'backtest/result/20261106_p50_stability')] for job in state['account_jobs']: retained.append(str(ROOT/job['session'])) row.setdefault('derived_account_validations',[]).append({'H':20,'label_treatment':job['label'],'rule':job['rule'],'model_ref':eid+'/arms/h20/'+job['label'],'evaluation':job['evidence']['path'],'session_dir':job['session']}) row['result_dirs']=sorted(set(row['result_dirs']+[str(Path(p).relative_to(ROOT)) for p in retained])) row['configs']=list(dict.fromkeys(row['configs']+[str(PLAN.relative_to(ROOT)),str((BASE/'configs'/f'{PREFIX}-accounts.json').relative_to(ROOT))]))
